messages:
Jules Martin: Hi team, Jules here (first day!). Trying to run a tiny inference test in ap-southeast1 but VM network create fails with 403. Okta login works. Who links projects to billing and can approve a short external IP for data download?

Ria Kapoor: Welcome Jules! Likely the project isn't linked to billing or you don't have projectCreator. Which project id?

Jules Martin: I was trying redwood-apac-tryout. Error: "Permission denied (403) calling resource: cloudresourcemanager.projects.create". Need a temp external IP to pull a 2GB dataset.

access-bot: Created ticket PROJ-2026-14077: Link project redwood-apac-tryout to billing 01A2B3-C456D and grant temporary external IP exception (24h) for jules@redwood.ai. ETA 2 hours.

Ria Kapoor: We'll also add you to group `apac-devs` and give viewer + kms encrypter if you need CMEK. For AWS logs, which account do you need read access to?

Jules Martin: AWS acct 444333222111 for logs. Thanks!

DevInfra Team: Added Jules to apac-devs and queued aws group add to aws-logs-readers. Once billing is linked try `gcloud compute addresses create temp-eip --region=ap-southeast1` after the exception is granted.

Jules Martin: Thanks all 44b will wait for the ticket and report back.

access-bot: PROJ-2026-14077 status: billing linked. Exception approved for 24h.

Jules Martin: Confirmed VM and data pull succeeded. All good, thanks!
